concept: SQS: buffer requests when downstream is unavailable (loose coupling)
tests: Which pattern keeps the system working while a dependency is temporarily unavailable.
expected: An SQS queue buffers requests, processing is asynchronous — the consumer catches up after recovery. Triggers: "downstream dependency temporarily unavailable", "buffering requests", "loose coupling".
why_not: Synchronous REST and direct TCP connections fail along with the dependency; a shared table with polling is fragile tight coupling.
